articles.headline: Will Lankshear scores brace as Middlesbrough come back to survive scare and beat Lincoln
articles.description: Marquee signing Will Lankshear notched a second-half double as Middlesbrough fought back to kick off their Championship bid with a hard-fought 2-1 victory and inflict a first defeat in eight and a half months on newly promoted Lincoln.

images.caption: Will Lankshear celebrates scoring the winning goal for Middlesbrough against Lincoln.

images.credit: Bruce Rollinson/PA Images via Getty Images

images.name: Will Lankshear [1296x729]
images.caption: Will Lankshear scored his first Championship goal for Middlesbrough to level the scores.
images.alt: Middlesbrough's Will Lankshear (right) celebrates scoring their side's first goal of the game during the Sky Bet Championship match at the Riverside Stadium, Middlesbrough. Picture date: Saturday August 15, 2026.

articles.headline: Nestory Irankunda leaves Watford for Portuguese giants Sporting CP
articles.description: Australia international Nestory Irankunda will feature in the UEFA Champions League this season after joining Portuguese giants Sporting CP.

images.caption: Nestory Irankunda, who became Australia's youngest scorer at a men's World Cup back in June, has joined Portuguese giants Sporting CP after one season in the Championship with Watford.

articles.headline: Raúl Jiménez marks Wolves return by rescuing draw with Blackburn

articles.headline: Dastan Satpayev signs Chelsea deal, joins Burnley on loan

seasonseries.title: Preston North End vs. Stoke City

keyEvents.text: Goal! Preston North End 0, Stoke City 1. Sorba Thomas (Stoke City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Junior Tchamadeu with a cross.

Goal! Preston North End 1, Stoke City 1. Alfie Devine (Preston North End) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Andrew Moran with a through ball following a fast break.
Alfie Devine (Preston North End) is shown the yellow card.
Benjamin Whiteman (Preston North End) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Million Manhoef (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Stoke City. Sam Gallagher replaces Milan Smit.
Substitution, Stoke City. Jesurun Rak-Sakyi replaces Junior Tchamadeu.
Substitution, Stoke City. Bae Jun-Ho replaces Steven Nzonzi because of an injury.

Goal! Preston North End 2, Stoke City 1. Milutin Osmajic (Preston North End) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Lewis Dobbin with a cross following a set piece situation.

Goal! Preston North End 3, Stoke City 1. Alfie Devine (Preston North End) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Milutin Osmajic with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, Preston North End. Thierry Small replaces Andrija Vukcevic.
Substitution, Stoke City. Divin Mubama replaces Million Manhoef.
Substitution, Preston North End. Brad Potts replaces Andrew Moran.
Substitution, Preston North End. Daniel Jebbison replaces Milutin Osmajic.
Substitution, Preston North End. Odeluga Offiah replaces Pol Valentín.
Substitution, Preston North End. Michael Smith replaces Lewis Dobbin.
Second Half ends, Preston North End 3, Stoke City 1.
